text:
sam_sales: Hey team — kicking off a Zephyr enterprise POC. They want hosted API keys for quick testing, but also a Dedicated pool and a VPC path if we move forward. Primary ask: a billing project with a $10k spend cap for the 30‑day POC + $5k in trial credits. Can we confirm what's possible and next steps?

maria_solutions: Thanks @sam_sales. Quick answers: hosted keys + trial credits are straightforward. Dedicated + VPC need capacity request + security review. Billing project can be created for the POC — need approver + billing owner email.

liam_eng: Re: Dedicated lead time — realistically 2–4 weeks to reserve a pool depending on region. If they need faster throughput for the POC, we can provision hosted with a higher quota and autoscale, but not guaranteed SLA.

kevin_finops: Two notes on the spend cap: we don't have a hard kill-switch at the infra level for hosted usage today. We provide quotas (rate/token limits), alerts, and a soft spend cap that pauses key usage when threshold hit — ops intervention required for absolute cutoff. For Dedicated we can enforce usage against the reserved commit. For billing project creation I need: company billing email, PO number (optional), and whether they want invoices to go to finance.

sam_sales: Can we implement TTL'd ephemeral keys for the POC so they don't accidentally run long jobs? Zephyr prefers ephemeral keys for sandboxing.

maria_solutions: Yes — we can create short-lived API keys (default TTL 24h) and a set of long-lived service keys for CI if needed. I can create a small script to mint ephemeral keys via our internal CLI.

liam_eng: Example CLI for ephemeral key minting (internal):
```
redwoodctl keys create --project zephyr-poc --ttl 24h --scopes generation,embeddings
```
This will return a one-time secret. Also add rate limits: `--rate 100r/s` for the POC route.

kevin_finops: On credits: we can apply $5k trial credit to the billing project. That reduces immediate charge, but spend cap behavior still as above. Recommend: set project quota (token cap) to approximate $10k and wire up alerts to Zephyr and our CS.

aml_security: Heads up: for VPC/private we need CIDR ranges, allowed egress IPs, and an internal contact for firewall rules. Also need signed DPA + proof of SOC2. If Zephyr needs an on‑prem package we start the security onboarding checklist — expect 1–2 weeks for questionnaire and certs verification.

ops_oncall: If we need a hard stop on usage during POC, ops can flip a project-level block but that is manual. We can automate it via an internal runbook if you want — requires a ticket and an owner to approve automated kills.

maria_solutions: Proposal for minimal path: 1) create billing project `zephyr-poc` and attach $5k credit, 2) mint ephemeral keys for initial tests, 3) set project token quota equivalent to $10k, 4) enable alerts to zephyr@ and to CS. If they request Dedicated/VPC, open capacity + security intake in parallel.

sam_sales: Perfect. I'll get the billing contact and PO. Please create the billing project and ephemeral-key playbook. @liam_eng can you open the capacity request if I tell you the region (us-west2)?

liam_eng: Yep — open a capacity request as soon as you share region + expected qps. I'll tag eng-runtime and eng-infra.

kevin_finops: I'll prepare the internal billing record and note that this is a trial POC (credits applied). Send me approver email and PO and I'll create the project.

maria_solutions: Adding checklist for the POC setup: 
- billing project created + $5k credit applied
- token quota set to $10k equivalent
- ephemeral key script + example CLI for Zephyr
- alerting to Zephyr & CS + escalation contact
- security intake opened for VPC/Dedicated (if requested)

sam_sales: Thanks — I'll DM the billing details and the region. Quick ask: can we include a short note in the onboarding email telling Zephyr that the spend cap is a quota+alert and not an absolute kill-switch? Want to avoid surprises.

maria_solutions: Yes — I'll draft a short paragraph explaining soft cap behavior and steps to request a hard pause (ops ticket). Drafted text: "Note: the POC will have a token-based quota and monitoring that aims to keep spend within $10k. If you need a hard stop, our team can perform a manual pause on the project — please request via support@redwood.com and include the project id."

sam_sales: Awesome. I'll close once I get PO. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: create-billing-project/zephyr-poc — queued by kevin_finops — ETA 3m.

kevin_finops: Billing project created: zephyr-poc. Applied $5k credit. Project ID: rwd-zt-00123. Please confirm keys + quotas.

maria_solutions: Got it — I'll run the ephemeral key script and set token quota to the $10k equivalent now. Will post example key (masked) and TTL.

liam_eng: Capacity request opened (REQ-4421) for us-west2 Dedicated pool — tagging eng-runtime. ETA estimate: 3 weeks.

aml_security: Security intake created for Zephyr POC (SEC-778). Sent questionnaire link to sam_sales.

ops_oncall: If you want the automated stop runbook, please open a task in #eng-oncall with the project id — we can automate within 48h.

maria_solutions: Done — ephemeral key minted (masked): sk_live_****wxyz TTL 24h. Quota set. Alerts wired to zephyr@ and cs@redwood.com.

sam_sales: Thanks everyone — moving to DM with billing and sending questionnaire to Zephyr. Will update when they accept the DPA.

maria_solutions: Thanks — marking thread resolved from sales side. :white_check_mark:
